newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: U.N. seeks quick $325 mln for central Africa aid.
newsitem.headline: U.N. seeks quick $325 mln for central Africa aid.

text.p: The United Nations on Wednesday appealed to the international community for $325 million in emergency aid to help refugees in central Africa's troubled Great Lakes region.
The appeal was issued in Geneva by the world body's Department of Humanitarian Affairs (DHA), and was aimed at helping nearly 1.5 million people displaced from their homes by the region's conflicts.

DHA said the situation throughout the region, exacerbated by the civil war in Zaire, presented the outside world with one of the worst humanitarian crises it had faced, and called on donor countries "to respond generously and without delay."
It said the funds were needed for 460,000 people in Zaire, 615,000 in Burundi, 326,000 in Tanzania, and 33,000 in Uganda and Zambia.
The government of Rwanda had asked for its own humanitarian requirements not to be included in the appeal, DHA said.
